summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Harry Elderfield's education and early academic career. It records his schooling at Eston Grammar School and his study at the University of Liverpool, where he earned a Bachelor of Science in chemistry (oceanography) in 1965. It then covers his research fellowship in the Geology Department at Imperial College London from 1968 to 1969, and his PhD from the University of Liverpool in 1970.
one_line: Biographical entry on Harry Elderfield's education at Eston Grammar and the University of Liverpool, and his research fellowship at Imperial College London.
key_facts: Harry Elderfield was educated at Eston Grammar School.

Harry Elderfield was completing his PhD at the University of Liverpool while working as a research fellow at Imperial College London.
